name: Or'Kalar's Head
summary: Or'Kalar's Head is proof that Hammerfall's attacks have a dangerous source. Korin Fel asks you to bring it to her at the outpost.

sections.title: A Threat at Hammerfall
sections.body: Korin Fel sends you to find Or'Kalar near the Tower of Arathor. The ogre serves Mug'thol in Stromgarde and bears a fierce hatred for Korin's husband, who defeated him years ago. Korin believes Or'Kalar has laid a trap for her husband. She asks you to slay him and bring his head to Hammerfall.

faq.answer: Or'Kalar is an ogre in Stromgarde who serves Mug'thol and hates Korin Fel's husband for defeating him years ago.

faq.q: Why does Korin Fel want Or'Kalar dead?
faq.answer: Korin believes Or'Kalar has laid a trap for her husband and wants the ogre slain to protect him and Hammerfall.
Or'Kalar is near the Tower of Arathor in the Arathi Highlands.
Korin Fel receives Or'Kalar's Head at the Hammerfall outpost.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you can help protect Hammerfall and Korin Fel's husband from Or'Kalar's attack.
